sources.citation: Joseph, Nidhin. 2024 [fieldwork 2014]. A Sociolinguistic Survey of the Kudiya Language in Karnataka and Kerala. Journal of Language Survey Reports 2024-007. Dallas: SIL International. 33 pp.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 4 (printed p.6, PDF p.12): 'There is a lack of documentation and analysis of the Kudiya language. During their preparation period, the researchers could not find any published sources about the Kudiya language.' Sec. 5 (p.9): 'There is virtually no documentation of the Kudiya language and very little is known about it.' Appendix A (pp.11-19): 210-item IPA wordlists for Kudiya G1 (Poomala clan, Kodagu) and K1 (Thenmala clan, Kasaragod) plus Kodava; no stress marks anywhere.
